cases.query: What daily review is required before opening?

relevant.quote:
## Daily review

Staff review the room, supplies, and visitor register before opening. Report damage promptly and leave a short written note for the next shift. This routine keeps the center ready for classes and community meetings. Supervisors also check that the first aid supplies are sealed, the posted contact list is current, and the maintenance log has a dated entry for every repair. They note any item that needs replacement, assign an owner, and confirm the follow-up during the next opening review. A clear record helps each shift understand what was inspected and what still needs attention.
